scope: First agreed priority: visibility and recovery of saved invoice/payment operations
deployment: Publish widget assets together; no CRM function changes required
behavior: Collapsible Operations to complete notice in the shared header area, visible only when saved operations or storage errors exist.
Recognizes supplier invoice registration, invoice edits/deletions, payment registration/allocation edits/deletions, card invoice/payment registration and unfinished prepayment checkpoints.
Review / resume opens the existing form or deletion confirmation. No new financial writes, automatic retries or recovery dismissal path introduced.
Completed prepayment checkpoints are excluded. Corrupt journals and old deletion recoveries remain visible for manual review.
Checks browser storage every two seconds while visible, plus focus/storage events; no CRM polling.
Active saves block recovery routing. Existing validation and idempotency safeguards remain in the original flows.

verification.browser_test: Passed empty/populated states, routing callback, escaped labels, preserved journals, failed-open retry, corrupt data, 390/1280 widths and completed-operation removal

limitations: Browser-local visibility only: other browsers/users and operations with no retained journal are not listed.
Journal state identifies unconfirmed work, not necessarily a failed operation; an operation may still be running.
Unavailable/deleted invoice records can require manual recovery review; saved journal is preserved.
Settlement consistency check action and expanded payment summary are subsequent priorities, not included in this change.
